cs.t: Switching everything to USB-C. It makes everything much simpler, especially when backpacking. Everything charges everything using the same cables. At last I also found a USB-C shaver (from Manscaped). That aside, the desk on my balcony. I loooove working outdoors among my plants and hearing birds sing. I also got my money's worth with Airpod Pros. I carry them almost everywhere. They're great when working in coffee shops and noisy environments.
